scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ELECTRON" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix shared install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix electron install
